# A big step forward for SJH Fulfilment. | SJH Fulfilment · LinkedIn · 2026-09-07

**SJH Fulfilment**: Order fulfillment company based in Kilkeel, NI - offering receiving, warehousing, picking, packing and delivery solutions for businesses. SJ Henderson Fulfilment Ltd has 1-10 employees (+60% YoY), founded in 2016. Headquartered in Kilkeel, Northern Ireland, United Kingdom.

---

A big step forward for SJH Fulfilment.

Today, we’re announcing a £3.5 million investment in our new 46,000 sq ft Greater Belfast fulfilment facility.

The expansion more than doubles our warehousing footprint in Northern Ireland, taking us from 37,500 sq ft to 83,500 sq ft, and will support 25 permanent jobs at the new site over the next three years.

This investment gives us the capacity to work with larger brands, strengthens our ability to support businesses trading across GB and the EU, and provides the foundations for the next stage of SJH’s growth.

We’ve already secured a significant contract with a major US-based brand for the new facility, and we’re setting ourselves an ambitious target: £50 million in revenue by 2036.

results.author: Mike Macdonald
results.text:
VB Distribution Expands Ahead of UK’s Vape Duty Change - Tobacco Reporter

# VB Distribution Expands Ahead of UK’s Vape Duty Change

VB Distribution announced the opening of a new 100,000-square-foot business park in Lancashire, England, expanding its national warehousing network to 500,000 square feet and strengthening its customs bonded storage capacity ahead of the U.K.’s Vaping Products Duty, which takes effect on Oct. 1. The company said the HMRC-approved bonded warehouse will allow duty-suspended storage, helping retailers better manage inventory and cash flow as the new tax is implemented.

Company CEO Natalia Gosciniak said the investment positions VB Distribution to provide compliant stock and supply continuity, alleviating cost pressures faced by smaller distributors without bonded infrastructure. VB Distribution, which supplies more than 50,000 retail shelf placements across the U.K. and reports an annual turnover of £500 million, said the facility is fully operational and could create up to 1,000 jobs as part of its broader expansion strategy.

## Bramble Foods opens new distribution hub and eyes expansion

31st July 2026

Kieran Howells

Bramble Foods has opened a new 67,000 sq ft national distribution centre in Market Harborough as the family-owned fine food supplier prepares to expand its workforce.

The LDC-backed business has moved into Lancaster House at Airfield Business Park, a purpose-built facility developed by Leicestershire County Council.

The site will become Bramble Foods’ main UK distribution hub, increasing its warehousing and stockholding capacity as it expands its product range and customer base.

Bramble Group, which includes Whitakers Chocolates, The Bay Tree and Lings, currently employs around 300 people and expects the new facility to support the creation of up to 50 skilled roles over the coming years.

Long-serving employee opens new site

The centre was officially opened by Steve Heighton, who is celebrating 50 years working alongside the Foster family and Bramble Foods.
